name: PrimXObject::Prim73 (SimAntics opcode 0x73, Debug)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Debug console primitive: returns 1 at once unless the cached singleton (0x20ddfb) slot 31 says yes; builds the object's and the person's "name, ID n" texts; when this+0x44 is set and the settings object (context slot 3) slot 15(0x21) has bit 3, runs param byte +0x11: 0 and 6 format a string-table text (loader 0x1d0df0, group 0x132, flag 1) with four operands (0 builds and drops the line, 6 sends it to the console, the cached service 0xb38f10 slot 7), 1 log filter/window commands through the log service holder (0x1bf8fb/0x1be5d1; slots 12, 9), 2 toggles person flag 0x8000 (displayAnimBillboard), 4 showbones, 5 toggles flag 0x4000, 7 (also when the gate fails) dumpHappy. ORIGINAL-BUG: sub-commands 2 and 4 (and 6 with only flag bit 0 set) use the person / language entry without a null check. The string-table loader 0x1d0df0 is an original callee (redirected to a stand-in in the test). 30,000 seeds with exception injection against recording fakes, strings compared by content. Mutants killed (5): flag 0x4000 constant, log group number, loader entry +1, dumpHappy text, language slot 70. Trace suite should exercise: Debug with the console enabled (usually the gate is false: the common path is the early return).

name: PrimXObject::Prim2E (SimAntics opcode 0x2e, Snap)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game; no difftest, by the process change). Snap: stack object found in the context's slot-26 list by the frame id (error 0x15); errors 0x17 when this object has flag 0x10000 or 0x20000, 8/0x1b/0x20/0x24 for bad slot numbers. Target by param word +6: 2 beside the stack object (tile + unit offset of its rotation notch, table of 8), 1 on it, 0 a slot via the frame's table, 3 and 4 a slot number (data word 0x96 when word +8 bit 3) or an entry of its slot-63 list; the slot entry may name a stack object slot (slot 56 >= 0) or give a free offset rotated by the notch quaternion (0x7dccd0, 0x1a6c40). Param word +0xe == 1 starts from the stack object's position plus the rotated slot offset. Then the worker 0x5a6780 (vec3 x2 by value, 8 more arguments) runs with a snap state (0x20 bytes, 0x7f02f0/0x7f04e0); on result != 1 it stores error codes into data word 0x34 (slot 14) and builds debug texts that are dropped. Inlined helpers: 0x45c160, 0x57ce60, 0x57c660, 0x7dcc50, 0x7dd090, 0x57c690, accessors. Float vector math is identical in order to the original (SSE single precision). The trace suite should exercise: all five modes of param word +6 (0, 1, 2, 3, 4), the slot-entry branches (entry slot >= 0 and < 0), word +0xe == 1, the failure branch (result != 1: outcome short non-zero, report code 0xc with and without the person-move interface, other codes), and the debug-text gate (context slot 31).
